description.platform: Sending provider and default sender of the platform's e-mails, inherited by partners.
description.partner: Sender of the e-mails you and your customers receive.

provider.title: Sending

description.platform: E-mails leave through Resend, from an address on a verified platform domain.
description.partner: E-mails leave through Resend, from the platform's address, with this level's name and reply-to.

provider.offHint: Sending is off: set RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS on the server. Until then, notices are recorded but not sent.

sender.title: Sender

description.platform: Default name and reply-to address. Empty uses the brand. Locking stops partners from changing it.
description.partner: Name and reply-to address of your customers' e-mails. Empty inherits from the platform or uses your brand.

sender.hint: The sending address is always the platform's; an address on your domain comes once the sending domain is verified.
sender.readOnly: Only owners and admins change the sender.

errors.notConfigured: E-mail sending is not configured on the server.
errors.provider: The e-mail provider refused the message. Check the key and the sending address.
errors.noAddress: Your account has no e-mail to receive the test.

templates.title: Email templates

description.platform: Subject and body of each email, per language. This is the base partners inherit.
description.partner: Subject and body of the emails your customers receive, per language, over the platform's base.

invitation.name: Invitation
invitation.description: Sent when someone is invited to an organization.

emailTest.name: Test email
emailTest.description: Sent by the test button in Settings › Email.

pastDue.name: Payment overdue
pastDue.description: Tells the partner a customer's subscription is overdue.

suspended.name: Subscription suspended
suspended.description: Tells the partner a customer's subscription was suspended.

aiKeyBackup.name: AI backup key
aiKeyBackup.description: Tells the customer the AI key failed and the backup is in use.

aiKeyPaused.name: Agent paused
aiKeyPaused.description: Tells the customer the agent was paused because the key was not fixed.

workspaceDeletionScheduled.name: Workspace deletion scheduled
workspaceDeletionScheduled.description: Tells the owner and admins that the workspace's deletion was requested and until when it can be canceled.

workspaceDeletionReminder.name: Deletion reminder
workspaceDeletionReminder.description: Tells the owner and admins 7 days before the workspace is deleted for good.

workspaceDeletionCanceled.name: Deletion canceled
workspaceDeletionCanceled.description: Tells the owner and admins that the workspace's deletion was canceled.

workspaceDeletionCompleted.name: Workspace deleted
workspaceDeletionCompleted.description: Tells the owner and admins that the workspace was deleted for good.

templates.essential: Essential email: it cannot be turned off.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.variablesHint: Click to insert where the cursor is. Only this event's variables work, and every value is escaped.

variableNames.data: Deadline date and time (invitation expiry, end of backup or workspace deletion)
variableNames.link: Address of the action button (use it as a link)
variableNames.proximo_passo: Sentence with the next step and the suspension date

restoreMessage.platform: The subject and body of this language go back to the system's default text.
restoreMessage.partner: The subject and body of this language go back to the platform's base.

templates.formatHint: Simple format: **bold**, *italic*, [text](https://...), lists with - or 1. and headings with ##. HTML is not accepted.
templates.layoutHint: Header and footer come from the brand (name, color and support contacts). Passwords are never sent by email.
templates.readOnly: Only the owner and admins change templates.

errors.newline: The subject must be a single line.
errors.bad_link: Links only with an http(s) address or the link variable.
errors.tag_not_link: The variable {tag} is not an address and cannot be a link.
